analysis.d: '3I ATLAS HYDROXYL', SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-06: 'Hydroxyl (OH) radicals—a direct breakdown product of water vapor—have been detected in the third confirmed interstellar object, 3I/ATLAS, through both ultraviolet and radio observations': Swift's ultraviolet OH ('outgassing rates reaching roughly 40 kg per second even while far out beyond 2.5 AU from the Sun') and MeerKAT's radio absorption ('This marked the first radio detection of hydroxyl radicals from 3I/ATLAS, observed shortly after its solar conjunction in October 2025.'). Three cards: Avi Loeb's Medium essay on the radio detection, Phys.org, and the arXiv water-production paper.

findings: A BASELINE WITHOUT A VERDICT. The composition reports Swift's OH ultraviolet and MeerKAT's OH absorption and stops: no 'ruling out', no 'confirmed natural'. The same MeerKAT detection at the band address (3i-atlas-1667-mhz-aio-20261106) carries 'ruling out artificial origin claims'.

LOEB AS A SOURCE CARD, ABSENT FROM THE BODY. The first card is Loeb's essay: 'First Radio Signal from 3I/ATLAS: Absorption by Hydroxyl Radicals (OH Molecules) Avi Loeb Follow 9 min read Nov 8, 2025'. The body cites the detection and names no one; at this address Loeb appears where he reported the natural line, and at '3i/atlas' he is absent where his ranking of the object would stand.

SMALLEST REPAIR. None needed for accuracy; the authors (the MeerKAT team; the Swift water-production paper's authors) could be named. COUNTERTEST: none; the address serves as the control for the band address.
